name: storefront-mcp
description: MCP server template for e-commerce storefronts: public catalog tools for AI agents, guarded write tools (checkout, back-in-stock alerts), token-gated back-office tools for you. Runs standalone via `npx storefront-mcp` (stdio) or as a Next.js App Router route.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:cli
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test "dist-test/tests/*.test.js" && npm run build:cli && node --test "test/**/*.test.mjs"
